name: Flowbite Icons
about: Flowbite Icons is a free, open-source icon set with 833 icons designed by Themesberg. From navigation and actions to files, media and communication, it covers everyday UI needs. Every icon is available as SVG, PNG and WebP, or as a copy-paste React / TypeScript component or CDN link. Recolor and resize each one in the browser before you export – free, no account needed. Licensed under MIT.

faqs.q: Are Flowbite Icons free to use?
faqs.a: Yes. All 833 Flowbite Icons are open source under the MIT license – free to download, customize and use. Always check the MIT terms for attribution or commercial-use requirements.

faqs.q: How do I use Flowbite Icons in React or my website?
faqs.a: Copy any icon as a React / TypeScript component straight into your project, or paste the CDN link into your HTML. Every icon also downloads as SVG, PNG or WebP, and you can recolor and resize it in the browser before you export.

faqs.q: How many Flowbite Icons are there?
faqs.a: There are 833 icons in the Flowbite Icons set, designed by Themesberg. Use the search above to find any icon by name.

faqs.q: Can I change the color and size of Flowbite Icons?
faqs.a: Yes. Open any icon, pick a size and color, and the preview updates instantly. SVG, PNG and WebP exports follow your choices, and React snippets recolor through props.

faqs.q: What formats are Flowbite Icons available in?
faqs.a: SVG, PNG and WebP downloads, copy-paste React / TypeScript components, plus a CDN link for every single icon – free, no account needed.
